extraction_limitations: All atoms remain needs_review because extraction was model-assisted and has not received independent human source verification.
The current LiteratureAtom QuantitativeResult stores one estimate per atom; multi-arm table context is retained in arm observations and the SEA artifact.

The source reports a treated-set placebo n=229 in Table 5 although 228 participants were randomized to placebo. The extraction preserves the source table denominator rather than silently reconciling it.

The supplement contains a text-layer row whose extracted values are not internally reliable. That row was not promoted into an atom; only visually and textually concordant sensitivity results were used.
